english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for regret about an unfortunate outcome, missed opportunity, or unfulfilled wish.
Use this as a noun for a regrettable situation or outcome, as in 一個遺憾.
Use this when the disappointment has a sense of regret or something regrettably falling short.
Use 遺憾 when “a shame” means something regrettable or disappointing rather than moral shame.

examples.english: It’s such a regret that we lost the match this time.
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 syu1 bo1 zan1 hai6 hou2 wai4 ham6

examples.english: Not winning the championship was truly a pity.
examples.traditional: 未能奪冠，實在係一個遺憾。
examples.jyutping: mei6 nang4 dyut6 gun1 sat6 zoi6 hai6 jat1 go3 wai4 ham6

examples.english: It was a real disappointment that they didn't come in the end.
examples.traditional: 佢最後冇嚟，真係好遺憾。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 mou5 lai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 wai4 ham6

examples.english: It’s a real shame that this trip was cancelled because of the rain.
examples.traditional: 今次旅行因為落雨取消，真係遺憾。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 jan1 wai6 lok6 jyu5 ceoi2 siu1 zan1 hai6 wai4 ham6
